_comment: Template for a machine that is NOT the one this skill was developed on.
Copy it to profiles/<your-rig>.json and run:
doctor will tell you which entries below are wrong and print ready-to-paste replacements.
Every absolute path here is a placeholder: replace it or let discovery find the tool.
None of these paths are used by the code directly -- the profile is the only place a
machine-specific path is allowed to live.
name: my-rig
_tools_comment: Executables. doctor searches the profile, then PATH, then the usual install directories, then the SEGGER registry keys -- so a wrong path here is a finding, not a dead end.
_probe_comment: jlink for a SEGGER probe (SEGGER's driver owns the device, OpenOCD cannot open it); openocd for CMSIS-DAP/ST-Link.
_openocd_comment: Only read when probe is openocd.
_target_comment: Properties of the board, not of the computer. Re-derive them on a new rig instead of copying them: a wrong value here produces plausible-looking numbers that are wrong.
isr_coverage: partial: FreeRTOS port hooks; application IRQ entry/exit not fully instrumented
_liveness_comment: OPTIONAL and normally best left out. The liveness check needs the address of FreeRTOS's
xTickCount, which is a property of one built image and moves on every rebuild. When this
key is absent the address is resolved from the ELF named above with arm-none-eabi-nm,
which is correct for whatever was built last. Set it only to override that, e.g. to watch
a different image than the one this profile builds.
